scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:components && npm run build
